acceptance_observations: A canonical-repository dev push or dev-targeting PR changing one listed input selects the workflow; a main-targeting event or unrelated path does not.
A selected canonical run has job contents read, timeout 15, pinned actions, uv.lock cache key, and executes the validator plus focused test; another repository fails the job guard.

Inspection of .github/workflows/sync-to-main.yml shows .github propagation may copy the new definition to consumer main; inspection of the copied definition shows no manual/main trigger, and its dev-only branches plus canonical repository guard make consumer-main/downstream copies non-executable without changing sync behavior or permissions.
constraints: Both automatic event filters are dev-only and carry identical complete path coverage.
Canonical-repository enforcement is at job execution; top-level permissions stay empty and contract job grants only contents read.
Third-party actions are full-SHA pinned; Python/tooling remains uv-managed.
Existing sync workflow and consumer-main behavior remain unchanged; propagated definitions are allowed only as inert copies.
exclusions: No workflow_dispatch, schedule, main event, executable downstream/consumer-main gate, broad test suite, unrelated lint, write permission, or modification of existing workflows/runtime packages.
proof_boundaries: actionlint .github/workflows/knowledge-source-contracts.yml when available plus a structured YAML assertion confirming triggers, equal paths, permissions, guard, timeout, SHAs, uv cache fields, validator command, and focused test command.
Source inspection of .github/workflows/sync-to-main.yml checkout/prune paths and the new workflow's inertness conditions.
required_outputs: Create .github/workflows/knowledge-source-contracts.yml with pull_request.branches: [dev] and push.branches: [dev]; give both equivalent path sets containing .owlbear/scripts/validate_agents.py, conftest.py, pyproject.toml, .python-version, uv.lock, serve/knowledge/**, serve/mcp-knowledge/**, share/agents/knowledge-ingestor.agent.md, share/prompts/kb-ingest.prompt.md, share/skills/h-knowledge-ops/SKILL.md, tests/test_knowledge_ops_contract.py, and .github/workflows/knowledge-source-contracts.yml.
